title: Choose starting-state and prove reset deliberately
when: Before scheduling QA that resets a host
need: A dedicated baseline needs golden capture plus restore proof, not just SSH or a saved archive. Verify/reset are destructive provisioning operations. No baseline is also a supported no-reset posture; an as_is case needs a reason. Capacity-machine registration is separate from test-machine registration. A nonzero native baseline probe retains its diagnosed quota, authentication, model or transport cause. Quota and unknown failures preserve the golden and do not justify sign-in or credential resets; authentication recovery needs actual native evidence. Linux reset must keep desktop Chromium sign-ins live outside goldens, preserve ~/snap/chromium/common/chromium only when present, never restore stale sign-in state from an older golden, and stop Chromium before preservation to flush its state. Require separate real reset and browser sign-in proof against the selected release. On Ubuntu24.04, Codex sandbox recovery audits the actual denied executable, grants userns only to that exact helper while retaining the global restriction at1, and requires ordinary sandbox command exit0/output in the same human-opened session plus fresh audit inspection. Re-audit after helper updates; renewed denial or missing helper blocks provisioning.
surface: Per-OS capture/verify/reset; machine setting optional baseline; Pack starting-state contract. Current Linux golden-home reference and Machine QA Linux baseline capture/recovery procedure.
gap: The entry guide must explain when a resettable rig is necessary. Do not make every browser user build a clean-install lab or mistake capacity registration for QA readiness.
review: Pending exact live recipe proof. The unmerged producer commit 5a4b84c0d7565f38cc2308df25950fd76d4fef0e implements the snap-store exclusion and conditional carry-forward in source. Producer-reported evidence is 29 targeted checks passing, CI run 39040788218 passing, and QA requirement 50631 artifact 36759. These are candidate source checks, not merged delivery or real reset/sign-in proof; those remain pending. Historical authorize commit 31b0cfaf30d303c729d936d49e178fa65e6faeed was an unmerged candidate with 53 focused checks and ruff PASS, but full CI run 39042681883 FAILED an unchanged automation-only remote-route consumer. The producer revised the contract in uncommitted source: --machine NAME --desktop-browser explicitly opts into automation then native Linux snap Chromium/macOS Safari in the same GUI process; --machine without that flag remains automation-only. Producer reports 70 focused checks PASS including that unchanged consumer. Exact corrective commit, new full CI, merge, real-host sign-in/reset and released delivery remain pending. Prior automatic native inclusion and native-only flag teaching are superseded. Scoped sandbox recovery has producer-reported actual proof on requirement 49008, QA run 50474, artifacts 36760 and 36761: same-session ordinary sandbox command exit0/output, scoped profile and global sysctl1. This proves that recovery only; overall installer and released recipe proof remain pending. A later api.upyoke.com DNS restriction is a separate blocker, not an AppArmor failure.
